nodes.label: Offline-First Sync Queue Architecture (Phase 1 design)
nodes.rationale: NER has spotty connectivity, so offline capability is non-negotiable. Games playable fully offline; SyncQueue model records offline actions (create/update/delete) by resource_type and syncs on reconnect. Offline-created sessions are fresh INSERTs — no conflict resolution needed for MVP (last-write-wins deferred to v2).

nodes.label: Pluggable LanguageServiceProvider (Bhashini/Mock)
nodes.rationale: Abstract LanguageServiceProvider (transcribe/synthesize/translate) lets Bhashini be swapped for Google/Whisper/local LLM without touching call sites. MVP ships MockLanguageProvider via get_language_provider(); BhashiniProvider activates once API keys are configured.

nodes.label: DPDP Compliance Foundation (ConsentRecord + AuditLog)
nodes.rationale: DPDP Act 2023 built as a first-class feature from day 1, not bolted on later: ConsentRecord (consent_type game_data/health_data/voice_companion, scope patient_self/guardian/joint) captured before any health-data storage; immutable AuditLog (read/write/delete); column-level AES-256 encryption at rest for sensitive fields.

nodes.label: JWT Auth + RBAC (Phase 1 design)
nodes.rationale: AuthService with bcrypt hashing + JWT (access 15m / refresh 7d) is stateless and scales horizontally; refresh tokens let rural field workers re-login without password in low-connectivity areas. require_role dependency factory enforces roles (patient/family_caregiver/asha_worker/clinician/admin) server-side.
